paragraphs.text:
Scene 1
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城
市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。
Grammar
古代的时候 → 在古代: Use 在古代 for this time setting. Put 在 before the time/place phrase.
孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家 → 孟子和孟母住在靠墓地的家: 住在 describes a state here, so do not put 了 before 在. Use 住在+Place.
(suggestion) …在靠墓地的家 → …在靠墓地的家里: It would be more natural to add 里 after 家, making the location clearer: 家里.
…天在墓地祭拜了 → …天在墓地祭拜: 每天 shows a habitual action, so sentence-final 了 is not needed here.
(suggestion) …母从早到晚都找工作 → …母从早到晚都在找工作: It would be more natural to use 在 for an action continuing from morning to night: 从早到晚都在找工作.
他们搬了到别一个城市… → 他们搬到了到别一个城市…: With 搬到, the directional complement 到 comes before 了. Use 搬到了+Place.
(suggestion) 他们搬了到别一个城市找… → 他们搬了别一个城市找…: It would be more natural to use 搬到了+Place rather than adding a separate 到 after 搬了.
Vocabulary
…和孟母住了在靠墓地的家 → …和孟母住了在靠近墓地的家: Use 靠近 to mean “near” a place. 靠近墓地 means “near the cemetery.”
他们搬了到别一个城市找工… → 他们搬了到另一个城市找工…: Use 另一个 for “another one.” 别一个 is not the standard expression here.
(suggestion) 墓地 (“在墓地祭拜”) → 墓园: a slightly more formal word for a cemetery; 坟地: a common, more everyday word for a burial place
(suggestion) 每天 (“每天在墓地祭拜了”) → 天天: a natural, conversational alternative meaning every day; 每日: a more formal alternative meaning every day
Coherence
Reference 孟子和孟母住了在…: 孟子 appears for the first time here, so please introduce him briefly, not only with his name.
Reference 孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地…: 孟母 appears for the first time here, so please introduce her briefly, for example as 孟子的妈妈.
Reference (suggestion) 在那个城市 → 在他们住的城市: It would be clearer to say 他们住的城市 because no city has been introduced for 那个城市 to refer to.
Connectors (suggestion) 原来买不了房 → 原来是因为买不了房: It would be more natural to use 原来是因为 to clearly introduce the reason.
Expressiveness
At “孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。 ”: Add that Mengzi found the rituals interesting and copied them playfully, so the reader can picture why this worried his mother. For example: 孟子觉得祭拜很好玩，常常一边笑一边学别人祭拜。
At “难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。 ”: Add Mengmu’s worried thought to show how she felt before deciding to move. For example: 孟母很着急，心想： “不能一直住在这儿。 ”
Encouragement You clearly set the story in ancient times and introduced Mengzi and his mother. You also gave a clear reason for why they decided to move.
Scene 2
这个城市老是很吵，不是人吵架，就是都叫，害得孟子一直不能睡觉。在那儿，孟母也找不到工作。孟子和妈妈要又一个次搬了家。在第三个城市，孟母找到工作，在商店做衣服。
Grammar
就是都叫 → 就是有人叫: 都 needs a clear plural referent. Use 有人 here to say that people are
shouting.
…要又一个次搬了家 → …要又一个次搬家: After 要, do not use completed-action 了. 要搬家
describes a planned action, not a completed one.
Vocabulary
(suggestion) 孟母找到工作 → 孟母找到了工作: It would be more natural to say 找到了工作,
because finding the job is a completed action.
(suggestion) 吵 (“这个城市老是很吵”) → 吵闹: means noisy and disorderly; it is a little more descriptive for a city or street.
(suggestion) 商店 (“在商店做衣服”) → 店铺: a common, slightly richer word for a shop or small store.
Coherence
Connectors 孟子和妈妈要又一个次搬了家 → 孟子和妈妈要再一次搬了家: use 再一次 here
because it means “one more time.”
Expressiveness
At “这个城市老是很吵，不是人吵架，就是都叫，害得孟子一直不能睡觉。 ”: Add a small detail about the noise and Mengzi’s tired feeling. For example: 从早到晚，街上很吵，孟子很累。
At “在那儿，孟母也找不到工作。 ”: Show Mengmu’s worry and let her say why she wants to move again. For example: 孟母很着急，说： “这里太吵了，我们再搬家吧。 ”
Encouragement You clearly explain the problem in this city and its effect on Mengzi’s sleep. Your use of “不是……就是……” makes the noisy situation easy to picture.
Scene 3
孟子在那个商店也找了到工作，可是不是做衣服的工作，而是喜欢的工作。孟子学习馆学了十五年，他的学习和他的旅行经验很重要，对他很多好处。他是大人的时候，他成为很有名的哲人。
Grammar
…做衣服的工作，而是喜欢的工作 → …做衣服的工作: The phrase 而是喜欢的工作 does not fit the meaning here, so delete it.
孟子学习馆学了十… → 孟子在学习馆学了十…: Use 在 before a place where an action happens: 在学习馆学了十五年.
对他很多好处 → 对他有很多好处: Use 有 in 对他有很多好处 to say something has many benefits for him.
Vocabulary
…在那个商店也找了到工作 → …在那个商店也找到了到工作: The person successfully finds a job, so use 找到find, not 找look for.
他是大人的时候 → 他长大后: Use the established time expression 长大后, not the literal combination 是大人的时候.
(suggestion) 他成为很有名的哲人 → 他成为了很有名的哲人: It would be more natural to add 了 after 成为 to show the completed change: 成为了很有名的哲人.
(suggestion) 重要 (“他的学习和他的旅行经验很重要”) → 关键: This means “key” or “crucial,” stronger than important.
(suggestion) 有名 (“很有名的哲人”) → 著名: This is a more formal and common word for “famous.”; 好处: This means “benefit,” and can make the sentence more concise.
Coherence
Reference 他成为很有名的… → 成为很有名的…: The subject is already clear from the previous clause, so delete 他. Chinese uses zero form here.
Expressiveness
At “孟子学习馆学了十五年”: Add that Mengzi enjoyed studying there and felt that the school was a good place for him. For example: 孟子很喜欢在那儿学习，觉得学校很好。
At “他的学习和他的旅行经验很重要，对他很多好处。 ”: Add Mengmu’s happy words about the new place being suitable for her child. For example: 孟母很高兴，说： “这儿很适合孩子学习！ ”
At “他成为很有名的哲人。 ”: Add a short comment from other people about why he became successful. For example: 人们都说： “孟子的成功离不开妈妈搬家。 ”
Encouragement You clearly show that Mengzi studied for a long time and later became a famous
philosopher. You also explain that his learning and experience helped him, which gives the ending a clear reason.
Content & completeness (after the whole story)
After they leave the graveyard area, add that they live near the market and 孟子 copies buying and selling.
Wrong information: “难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。 ” — 孟母 moves because she worries that copying sacrifices will negatively affect 孟子, not because she cannot afford a house.
Wrong information: “他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。 ” — The move away from the graveyard is prompted by 孟母's concern about 孟子 copying sacrifices, not by looking for work.

Scene 1
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。
Grammar
…他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里 → …他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩: 墓地里 is the location, so use 在+Place before the action: 在墓地里玩.
(suggestion) 而是因为妈妈认为他们… → 而是妈妈认为他们…: It would be more natural to say 而是妈妈认为…… because 而是 already introduces the contrasting reason, so 因为 is unnecessary.
Vocabulary
装祭拜 → 装作祭拜: Use 装作 before a verb phrase. Here, say 装作祭拜.
(suggestion) 玩 (“从早到晚都跟朋友玩”) → 玩耍: A slightly more story-like word for children playing.; 嬉戏: Means playing happily and noisily; it is more vivid.
(suggestion) 朋友 (“孟子和他的朋友”) → 伙伴: A natural word for companions who play or do things together.; 小伙伴: A warm, child-like word for young friends.
(suggestion) 近 (“离墓地太近”) → 靠近: Means “close to” and works well when describing a location.; 邻近: Means “nearby” or “next to”; it sounds a little more descriptive.
Coherence
Reference 孟子小的时候: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟子briefly with an identifying noun phrase, not only his name.
Other
(suggestion) 跟妈妈搬家 → 跟妈妈搬家了: It would be more natural to add 了 after 搬家 to show the move was completed.
Expressiveness
At “孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。 ”: Add that Mengzi watched people come to worship and found it interesting. For example: 他每天看见很多人来祭拜，觉得很好玩。
At “孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。 ”: Add a short line of speech to show the children copying the adults. For example: 孟子说： “我们也来祭拜吧！ ”
At “孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。 ”: Add that the children laughed while playing, which made the real visitors unhappy. For example: 他们一边笑一边玩，来祭拜的人很生气。
Encouragement You clearly explain Mengzi’s daily habit of playing with his friends and give a reason for the move. Using “不是……而是……” is also a good way to make the reason clear.
Scene 2
妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师
住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。
Grammar
住离墓地太近 → 住得离墓地太近: Use 得 after 住 to introduce the degree result: 住得离墓地太近.
(suggestion) …子思老师的家，跟子思老师住 → …子思老师的家住: It would be more natural to delete 跟子思老师 because 搬到子思老师的家 already shows where they will live.
Vocabulary
害得孟子的心气 → 伤了孟子的心气: 害得 needs a harmful result after 孟子的心气. Here, 伤了孟子的心气 is the natural expression.
(suggestion) 打扫 (“孟母帮子思打扫房间”) → 收拾: This means to tidy up and put things in order.
(suggestion) 做饭 (“孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭”) → 下厨: This is a slightly more vivid way to say “cook,” especially when someone cooks for others.
(suggestion) 读书 (“他老是读书”) → 学习: This is broader and can include reading, writing, and other school work.; 用功: This emphasizes studying hard and making a real effort.
Coherence
Reference 孟子和孟母搬到子思老师…: 孟母 appears for the first time, so please introduce her
briefly, for example 孟子的妈妈孟母.
Connectors (suggestion) 他老是读书 → 所以他老是读书: It would be more natural to add 所以 to show that having no friends is the reason for reading books often.
Expressiveness
At “孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。 ”: Add what Meng’s mother hopes for in the new place, using a short sentence of speech. For example: 孟母说： “这里很适合孩子学习。 ”
At “因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。 ”: Add how Meng feels about reading, to show that he is beginning to enjoy studying. For example: 孟子觉得读书很有意思。
At “子思帮孟母教她的儿子。 ”: Add a small detail about what Meng does while learning, such as reading books carefully. For example: 孟子每天认真看书学习。
Encouragement You clearly show the change after the move: Meng has no friends there, so he reads often. You also include how Meng’s mother and the teacher help each other, which makes the scene feel connected.
Scene 3
子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学
书。孟子从五岁一直学哲学。他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。
Grammar
孟子从五岁一直学哲学 → 孟子从五岁起一直学哲学: After 从五岁, add 起 to show the starting point: 从五岁起一直学哲学.
难怪他成为很有名的哲学… → 难怪他成为了很有名的哲学…: Becoming a famous philosopher is a completed event, so use 了 after 成为.
Vocabulary
就是看哲学书 → 就是看到哲学书: The person actually sees the philosophy books, so use 看到see, not 看look.
(suggestion) 有名 (“成为很有名的哲学家”) → 著名: Means “well-known” and is a little more formal.; 出名: Means “famous” and is common in everyday speech.
(suggestion) 读书 (“读书最重要”) → 阅读: Means “to read” and is more formal, often used for
reading books or texts.
Coherence
Reference 难怪他成为很有名的… → 难怪成为很有名的…: 孟子 is already clear from the previous sentence, so 他 is redundant. Chinese uses zero form here.
Expressiveness
At “孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。 ”: Add that Mengzi studies very seriously and is interested in philosophy. For example: 他很喜欢哲学，读得很认真。
At “孟子从五岁一直学哲学。 ”: Add a short quote from Mengzi’s mother to show that she feels happy about his learning environment. For example: 孟母很高兴，说： “这儿很适合孩子学习。 ”
At “他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。 ”: Add that his mother feels proud when she sees him become successful. For example: 孟母看到他很高兴，也很骄傲。
Encouragement You clearly show that Mengzi studied philosophy from a very young age. Your final sentence also connects his childhood learning to his later success as a philosopher.
Content & completeness (after the whole story)
After they leave the graveyard, add that 孟母 moves them near the market and 孟子 copies buying and selling.
After the market events, add that 孟母 moves them near a school before 孟子 studies every day.
Wrong information: “孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。 ” — The story requires them to move first to a neighborhood near the market, and later from the market to a neighborhood near a school; it does not say they move to 子思老师's home.

Scene 1
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。
Grammar
…常常跟朋友们祭拜玩 → …常常跟朋友们玩祭拜的游戏: Put 玩 before the activity being played. Say 玩祭拜的游戏.
Vocabulary
(suggestion) …在墓地的旁边影响孟子 → …在墓地的旁边会影响孟子: It would be more natural to say 会影响孟子 to show that living beside a cemetery may have this result.
所以孟母决定他们会搬家 → 所以孟母决定搬家: After 决定, use the action directly: 决定搬家. Do not add 他们会 here.
(suggestion) 常常 (“他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩”) → 总是: shows that he does it again and again, often with a slightly stronger feeling.; 经常: is a natural word for doing something frequently.
(suggestion) 商店 (“城市里的商店的旁边”) → 店铺: means shops and sounds a little more varied in a story.; 市场: means a marketplace, with many sellers and shops together.
(suggestion) 吵 (“从早到晚很吵”) → 热闹: describes a lively, busy place in a more positive way.; 嘈杂: focuses on the loud, mixed noises of a busy place.
Coherence
Reference 孟子跟孟母住在墓…: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce孟子 briefly with an identifying noun phrase, not only his name.
Reference 孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁…: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟母 briefly, for example as 孟子的妈妈.
Connectors 可是孟母注意 → 可是孟母注意到: Use 注意到 when you mean “notice” or “realize” a fact.
Expressiveness
At “他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩， ”: Add that Mengzi thinks copying the worshippers is fun, to show why he keeps doing it. For example: 他觉得祭拜很好玩。
At “所以孟母决定他们会搬家。 ”: Add Mengmu’s worried thought or speech about this place not being good for Mengzi. For example: 孟母想： “这里不适合孟子。 ”
At “这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。 ”: Add a detail about the many
merchants selling things, so the new neighborhood feels busy and lively. For example: 每天有很
多商人卖东西。
Encouragement You clearly show the first move from the cemetery to the city. You also give a reason for the move by explaining that Mengzi’s behavior affects his mother’s decision.
Scene 2
城市也有点儿危险。害得孟母只好一直陪孟子。孟子也没有朋友，难怪他老是看起来不高
兴。住在商店的旁边不是适合孟子，而是让他觉得很伤心。
Grammar
(suggestion) …母只好一直陪孟子 → …母只好一直陪着孟子: It would be more natural to say 一直陪着孟子. 着 shows that 陪 is a continuing action.
Vocabulary
…在商店的旁边不是适合孟子 → …在商店的旁边不但不适合孟子: this sentence needs the paired structure 不但……而且…… to add a second negative result. 而是让他觉得很伤… → 而且让他觉得很伤…: 不但 should pair with 而且, not 而是.
(suggestion) 城市 (“城市也有点儿危险。”) → 市中心: This is more precise for the busy central part of a city.
(suggestion) 不高兴 (“他老是看起来不高兴。”) → 难过: This more clearly shows that someone feels sad.; 孤单: This means lonely, which fits a child without friends.
(suggestion) 伤心 (“让他觉得很伤心。”) → 难受: This describes feeling upset or uncomfortable inside.; 失望: This means disappointed, when something is not as hoped.
Coherence
No corrections.
Expressiveness
At “城市也有点儿危险。 ”: You could describe the busy shops and sellers, so the city setting feels more vivid. For example: 每天有很多商人卖东西，很热闹。
At “害得孟母只好一直陪孟子。 ”: Add what Meng’s mother says to show that she is worried about his learning in this environment. For example: 孟母说： “这儿会影响孟子学习。 ”
At “孟子也没有朋友，难怪他老是看起来不高兴。 ”: Add a small detail about Meng’s feelings, such as missing friends or feeling lonely. For example: 他觉得很孤单，也很想朋友。
Encouragement You clearly show Meng’s unhappy feelings and explain how the environment affects him. Your use of “难怪” gives a natural reason for why he looks unhappy.
Scene 3
所以，孟母和孟子搬到学校的旁边住。才五岁孟子开始学哲学。在学校，孟子不是看书，就是练习写字。将来，他成为中国的一个非常有名的哲学家。
Grammar
No corrections.
Vocabulary
(suggestion) 他成为中国的一… → 他会成为中国的一…: It would be more natural to add 会 to show that becoming a famous philosopher was his future result. 成为 is correctly followed by the profession noun 哲学家.
(suggestion) 看书 (“孟子不是看书，就是练习写字。 ”) → 阅读: A more formal word for reading books or written materials.
(suggestion) 有名 (“一个非常有名的哲学家”) → 著名: A slightly more formal word meaning well known or famous.
(suggestion) 非常 (“一个非常有名的哲学家”) → 十分: A natural, slightly more formal intensifier meaning very.; 格外: It means especially or particularly, with a stronger emphasis.
Coherence
了 / 着 / 在 将来 → 后来: 将来 means “in the future,” but this is a later event in a past story. Use 后来 for the next story event.
Connectors 才五岁孟子开始学哲… → 才五岁时孟子开始学哲…: Use 时 after an age phrase to show the time when an action happened: 才五岁时。
Connectors (suggestion) 才五岁孟子开始学哲学 → 才五岁孟子就开始学哲学: It would be more natural to use 才Num.就V. to emphasize that he started learning at the early age of five.
Expressiveness
At “所以，孟母和孟子搬到学校的旁边住。 ”: Add that Meng’s mother feels happy because she thinks the school environment is good for her child. For example: 孟母很高兴，觉得这儿很适合孟子。
At “在学校，孟子不是看书，就是练习写字。 ”: Add a small detail about Mengzi studying seriously every day. For example: 孟子每天认真看书，也认真写字。
At “将来，他成为中国的一个非常有名的哲学家。 ”: You could add Meng’s mother’s happy words when she sees him begin to study. For example: 孟母说： “这次搬家太对了！ ”
Encouragement You clearly show the final move to the school and Mengzi’s new study routine. The pattern “不是……，就是……” makes his daily activities sound clear and natural.
Content & completeness (after the whole story)
After they move next to the market, add that 孟子 copies people buying and selling there.

Scene 1
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。
Grammar
古代的时候 → 在古代: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。
(suggestion) 也不知道什么植物对你… → 也不了解什么植物对你…: It would be more natural to say 了解什么植物对人的身体有好处.
…道什么植物对你的身体有好处 → …道什么植物对人的身体有好处: This means people in general, not the listener. Use 人 instead of 你.

…了这个植物对你有没有好处 → …了这个植物对人有没有好处: This refers to people in general, not the listener. Use 人 instead of 你.
Vocabulary
所以神农去了吃每种植物 → 所以神农去吃每种植物: 了 does not go between 去 and 吃. Use 去吃, without 了 in the middle.
(suggestion) 所以神农去了吃每种植物 → 所以神农去了每种植物: It would be more natural to omit吃 here.
(suggestion) 好吃 (“很好吃的植物”) → 可口: means tasty and pleasant to eat; it is a little more descriptive.; 美味: means delicious; it gives stronger praise for food.
(suggestion) 危险 (“很危险的植物”) → 有毒: means poisonous, so it is more precise for a harmful plant.
(suggestion) 很多 (“有很多人”) → 许多: means many; it is a slightly more formal story word.
Coherence
Reference 他的名字是神农: 神农 appears for the first time here, so please introduce him briefly with an identifying noun phrase before using his name or a pronoun.
Reference 所以神农去了吃每种植… → 所以去了吃每种植…: 神农 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
Reference …跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了 → …跟他的朋友聊他吃的植物了: 聊 takes its topic directly. Use 聊他吃的植物, without 到.
Reference …到他吃的植物了 → …到他吃的植物: 会 already describes a future or habitual action here, so do not add 了 at the end.
Content
…多人不知道哪个植物好吃 → …多人不知道哪种植物好吃: Use 种 for kinds of plants. 个 does not classify plants naturally here.
Expressiveness
At “这个问题神农觉得很糟糕”: Add what Shennong decides to do, using his own words. For example: 他想： “我要找一找什么植物可以做药。 ”
At “有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。 ”: Add a detail about how his body feels after he eats a poisonous plant. For example: 他吃了有毒的植物，肚子很疼。
At “他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。 ”: Add a short sentence
showing what he tells his friends about a plant. For example: 他对朋友说： “这个植物可以做药。 ”
Encouragement You clearly explain the problem that many people did not know which plants were good for the body. You also use “有的时候” to show that Shennong had different experiences with different plants.
Scene 2
一个人问神农，哪个植物好吃。神农说，这就要看你的口味了。要是你喜欢吃甜的，有很多甜的水果，比方说苹果、西瓜和梨。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有好处。神农说，有很多种植物对你的身体有好处，比方说小白菜、黄瓜、茶和菠菜。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有坏处。
Grammar
No corrections.
Vocabulary
哪个植物好吃 → 哪种植物好吃: Use 种 when asking about kinds of plants: 哪种植物好吃?
这就要看你的口味了 → 这就要看你的口味了: 看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see.” Here you are asking what the taste depends on, not describing a result of seeing, so use 看, not 看到.
一个别的人问神农 → 一个另外一个人问神农: This means an additional person, so use 另外, not 别的: 另外一个人。
哪个植物对你的身… → 哪种植物对你的身…: Use 种 when asking about kinds of plants: 哪种植物对你的身体有好处?
一个别的人问神农 → 一个另外一个人问神农: This means an additional person, so use 另外, not别的: 另外一个人。
(suggestion) 哪个植物对你的身… → 哪种植物对你的身…: It would be more natural to use 种 when asking about kinds of plants: 哪种植物对你的身体有坏处?
(suggestion) 好吃 (“哪个植物好吃”) → 美味: means delicious; it is a slightly more vivid and formal way to describe food.; 可口: means tasty and pleasant to eat; it often describes food or fruit.
(suggestion) 有好处 (“对你的身体有好处”) → 有益: means beneficial; it is a concise word often used for health.
(suggestion) 很多 (“有很多甜的水果”) → 各种各样: means many different kinds, emphasizing
variety.
Coherence
No corrections.
Expressiveness
At “神农说，这就要看你的口味了。 ”: You could add a short quote to make Shennong sound
friendly and explain that different people like different tastes. For example: 神农笑着说： “每个人喜欢的味道不一样。 ”
At “一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有好处。 ”: You could add that this person wants to stay healthy, so the question has a clear reason. For example: 他想让身体更健康。
At “一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有坏处。 ”: You could continue with Shennong’s warning that some plants are poisonous and can make people very sick. For example: 神农说： “有的植物有毒，吃了会肚子疼。 ”
Encouragement You clearly organize the scene as a question-and-answer conversation, and you give useful examples of fruits, vegetables, and tea. Your explanation of “口味” also makes Shennong’s answer sound sensible and connected to daily life.
Scene 3
神农说，有一天，我吃了一个黄色的花，名字是夹竹桃。我一吃夹竹桃，就觉得这种植物对我的脑有坏处。可是，一个灵芝和一个男人正好在我的旁边，我说，麻烦你把那个植物给我吃一下。我一吃这个灵芝就好了。所以，你得小心吃植物，因为有的植物对你的健康有坏处，特别是夹竹桃。因为夹竹桃有毒。
Grammar
No corrections.
Vocabulary
我吃了一个黄色的花 → 我吃了一朵黄色的花: Use the classifier 朵 for flowers: 一朵黄色的花.

名字是夹竹桃 → 它的名字是夹竹桃: 名字 needs a possessive subject here. Use 它的名字是夹竹桃.
…种植物对我的脑有坏处 → …种植物对我的大脑有坏处: Use 大脑, not 脑 alone, when you mean the brain.
一个灵芝和一个男… → 一株灵芝和一个男…: Use the classifier 株 for 灵芝: 一株灵芝.
(suggestion) 黄色 (“黄色的花”) → 金黄色: a bright, golden yellow; 淡黄色: a light, pale yellow (suggestion) 旁边 (“我的旁边”) → 身边: means close beside someone; it sounds natural for a person nearby
(suggestion) 小心 (“小心吃植物”) → 当心: a common, slightly stronger warning word; 谨慎: means careful and cautious, with a more serious tone
Coherence
No corrections.
Other
因为夹竹桃有毒 → 夹竹桃有毒: 因为 is redundant here because this is a separate statement, not a full reason clause. Say 夹竹桃有毒.
Expressiveness
At “有一天，我吃了一个黄色的花，名字是夹竹桃。 ”: You could describe the flower as big and beautiful, like a star, before Shennong eats it. For example: 那个花又大又漂亮，像星星一样。
At “我一吃夹竹桃，就觉得这种植物对我的脑有坏处。 ”: Add how badly Shennong feels after eating it, such as a stomachache and lying on the ground. For example: 我肚子很疼，难受得不得了，躺在地上。
At “我说，麻烦你把那个植物给我吃一下。 ”: You could add the man’s reply to make this moment sound more like a story. For example: 那个男人说： “快吃这个！ ”
Encouragement You clearly explain the danger of 夹竹桃 and give an important warning at the end. You also include how 灵芝 helps Shennong feel better, so the scene has a clear problem and solution.
Content & completeness (after the whole story)
After 神农 eats 夹竹桃 and before he receives 灵芝, add that he faints.

Scene 1
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。
Grammar
古代的时候 → 在古代: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。
(suggestion) 哪些植物不能吃 → 哪些不能吃: It would be more natural to omit the repeated 植物:哪些植物能吃，哪些不能吃。
Vocabulary
一看很多人正在吃… → 一看到很多人正在吃…: Shennong actually sees the people eating plants, so use 看到see, not 看look.
(suggestion) 路上 (“神农正在路上走”) → 山路: a mountain path; it gives a clearer picture of where he is walking.
(suggestion) 生病 (“一些人一吃植物就生病了”) → 中毒: to be poisoned; this is more precise when illness comes from harmful plants.
(suggestion) 知道 (“想知道哪些植物能吃”) → 了解: to find out or understand; it sounds a little
more formal.; 弄清楚: to work something out clearly; it shows careful investigation.
Coherence
了 / 着 / 在 (suggestion) 神农想帮别人 → 神农想帮助别人: It would be more natural to say 帮助别人 here.
Expressiveness
At “一些人一吃植物就生病了”: Add that the plants were poisonous and that the people felt very unwell. For example: 他们吃了有毒的植物，身体很不舒服。
At “神农想帮别人。 ”: You could add what Shennong says to show his decision to help. For
example: 神农说： “我要找出能吃的植物。 ”
At “一天，神农正在路上走”: Add a small detail about where he is walking, such as the mountains he visits to look for plants. For example: 神农在高山上走啊走啊。
Encouragement You clearly introduce the problem: people eat plants and become ill. You also explain Shennong’s helpful goal, which gives this scene a strong beginning.
Scene 2
然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。
Grammar
一些植物吃真好 → 一些植物真好吃: Use 真好吃, with 真 before the adjective 好吃. It describes how the plants taste.
Vocabulary
(suggestion) 一些植物毒得很 → 一些植物有毒得很: It would be more natural to say 有毒. Here you need the adjective form 有毒 to describe the plants.
(suggestion) 一些植物毒得很 → 一些植物毒: It would be more natural to say 有毒 without 得很. 有毒 is already the adjective that describes the plants.
(suggestion) 尝 (“神农开始尝很多植物”) → 品尝: This means to taste or try food, with a slightly more careful tone.; 试吃: This means to try eating something to see what it is like.
(suggestion) 很多 (“尝很多植物”) → 各种各样: This emphasizes that there were many different kinds.; 许多: This is a slightly more formal way to say “many.”
Coherence
No corrections.
Expressiveness
At “然后，神农开始尝很多植物”: You could add that he was willing to try them even though this was dangerous, to show his courage. For example: 他不怕危险。
At “一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。 ”: You could add what happened to Shennong after he ate the poisonous flower, such as a bad stomachache. For example: 他吃了以后，肚子很疼。
At “一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。 ”: You could add Shennong’s worried thought when he became ill. For example: 他想： “我会死吗？ ”
Encouragement You clearly show that Shennong tried both safe and poisonous plants. Your examples of ginger, Chinese kale, spinach, cucumber, and oleander make this scene more specific and interesting.
Scene 3
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。
Grammar
(suggestion) 一些植物不能吃 → 一些不能吃: It would be more natural to omit the second 植物 because it is already understood from the first phrase.
Vocabulary
这就要看你想不想生病… → 这就要看你想不想生病…: Here 看 means “depends on” in 要看……, so do not change it to 看到.
(suggestion) 一个人 (“一个人对神农说”) → 男人: This is more specific when the person is male.; 胖男人: This adds a simple visual detail about the character.
(suggestion) 告诉 (“神农告诉别人”) → 说明: This means to explain something clearly.; 提醒: This is useful when Shennong warns people about dangerous plants.
Coherence
No corrections.
Other
麻烦我们可以吃什… → 请问我们可以吃什…: Use 请问 to politely introduce a question. 麻烦 cannot directly introduce this question.
Expressiveness
At “一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？ ”: You could describe the person a little, such as his clothes or body shape, so the scene is easier to imagine. For example: 一个穿着咖啡色衣服的胖男人问神农。
At “神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。 ”: You could add Shennong’s direct explanation about one safe plant and one poisonous plant. For example: 神农说： “像伞一样的灵芝可以吃，是药。夹竹桃有毒，不能吃。”
At “以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。 ”: You could add that Shennong wrote these plants in his book, showing how he helped more people. For example: 他把这些植物都写在书上，帮助了很多人。
Encouragement You clearly show that Shennong teaches other people which plants are safe and which are dangerous. Your ending also shows the helpful result of his work.
Content & completeness (after the whole story)
After 神农 starts trying plants, add that he finds 茶 and writes it down.
After the safe plants, add that 神农 tries 夹竹桃 and faints.
After 神农 faints, add that a person gives him 灵芝, and he feels better after eating it.
After the conversation, add that 神农 records 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.
Wrong information: “神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。 ” — This wrongly says that whether plants can be eaten depends on whether a person wants to get sick; 神农 is finding out which plants are actually safe or poisonous.

Scene 1
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。
Grammar
也什么植物不能… → 也不知道什么植物不能…: The two parts are parallel: people do not know what plants can be eaten or what plants cannot be eaten. Add 不知道 after 也.
(suggestion) 也什么植物不能吃 → 也什麼植物不能吃: It would be more natural to use the
traditional character 麼 if you are writing in traditional Chinese.
吃不安全的植物对你的… → 吃有毒的植物对你的…: 有毒的植物 is the established phrase for plants that harm people when eaten, not 不安全的植物.
(suggestion) 吃不安全的植物对你的身体有… → 吃不安全的食品对你的身体有…: It would be more natural to say 食品 for harmful things people eat in this general statement.
…安全的植物对你的身体有坏处 → …安全的植物对人的身体有坏处: This is a general statement, so use 人的身体, not 你的身体.
但是一个人 → 但是有一个人: Use 有 to introduce a new person: 但是有一个人。
Vocabulary
古代的人很不知道什么植… → 古代的人不知道什么植…: 很不知道 is not an established expression. Say 不知道 here.
(suggestion) …很多人常常吃不安全的植物 → …很多人常常吃有毒的植物: It would be more specific to say 有毒的植物. 不安全的 is vague here.
(suggestion) …常吃不安全的植物 → …常吃不安全的食物: It would be more specific to say 食物 here, because this means food people eat.
很麻烦的情况 → 这是一个很麻烦的情况: 很麻烦的情况 is only a noun phrase. Add 这是一个 to make a complete sentence: 这是一个很麻烦的情况.
(suggestion) 很多 (“所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物”) → 许多: A slightly more written-style word for “many.”; 不少: Means “quite a few” and sounds natural in narration.
(suggestion) 解决 (“神农，要解决这个问题”) → 弄清楚: Means “find out clearly,” which fits
discovering which plants are safe.; 找出: Means “find out” or “identify,” especially useful for identifying plants.
Coherence
Reference 神农: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 神农 briefly, for
example 有一个叫神农的人.
Expressiveness
At “很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。”: You could add that people often became ill, to show why this problem was serious. For example: 很多人生病了。
At “但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。”: Add that Shennong felt worried about the sick people and wanted to find out which plants could be medicine. For example: 神农觉得很担心，想找可以做药的植物。
At “但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。”: You could include a short sentence from Shennong to make his decision more lively. For example: 神农说： “我要找出哪些植物可以吃。 ”
Encouragement You clearly explain the main problem at the start: people did not know which plants were safe to eat. You also introduce Shennong and his goal, so the scene has a clear direction.
Scene 2
他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。比方说，灵芝和夹竹桃。他一吃各种各样的植物就知道能不能吃这些植物。然后，神农写他的主意。他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。
Grammar
旅行很远找到很多植物 → 旅行很远找到了很多植物: This is a completed discovery, so use 找到了with 了.
Vocabulary
旅行很远找到很多植物 → 走了很远找到很多植物: 旅行很远 does not normally collocate with the action of going a long distance. Use 走了很远 instead.
神农写他的主意 → 神农写下了他的主意: When Shennong records his ideas, use 写下了, meaning “wrote down,” rather than just 写.
神农遇到了一个黄色的花 → 神农遇到了一朵黄色的花: Use 朵 as the measure word for flowers, not 个.
(suggestion) 聪明 (“他又聪明又努力”) → 了不起: means very admirable, and is good for praising Shennong’s work.; 勇敢: emphasizes that he is not afraid of danger.
(suggestion) 努力 (“他又聪明又努力”) → 勤劳: describes someone who works hard over a long
time.
(suggestion) 不舒服 (“一吃就觉得不舒服”) → 难受: is a stronger word for feeling physically bad.; 痛苦: shows very strong physical suffering.
Coherence
No corrections.
Expressiveness
At “他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。 ”: You could add that he went to many high
mountains, showing how hard he worked. For example: 他走了很多高山，找植物。
At “他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。 ”: You could describe the yellow flower as big and beautiful, like a star. For example: 黄色的花像星星一样，又大又漂亮。
At “神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。 ”: You could show his worry by adding what he thinks when his stomach starts to hurt. For example: 他的肚子疼起来。他想： “我会死吗？ ”
Encouragement You clearly explain that Shennong tests many plants and then records what he learns. You also include his reaction after eating the yellow flower, which helps the scene move toward the danger.
Scene 3
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。
Grammar
…友哪一个植物能不能吃 → …友哪一个植物能吃，哪一种不能吃: Do not combine 哪一种 with the yes/no form 能不能吃. List the two Wh-questions: 哪一种能吃，哪一种不能吃.
Vocabulary
(suggestion) 很快 (“别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。 ”) → 马上: means immediately, with a stronger sense of quick action.; 立刻: means at once and sounds a little more vivid in a story.
(suggestion) 信息 (“然后，他继续写他发现的信息。 ”) → 资料: means information or material collected for a book or study.; 内容: means the specific things he discovered and wrote down.
Coherence
了 / 着 / 在 发现了夹竹桃有毒 → 发现夹竹桃有毒: 发现 is a mental state verb here, so use no了.
了 / 着 / 在 (suggestion) 很快给他吃一个灵芝 → 很快给他吃了一个灵芝: It would be more natural to use 了 because giving him the 灵芝 is completed in the story (了completed).
了 / 着 / 在 (suggestion) …就觉得比较好 → …就觉得比较好吃: It would be more natural to say 吃了: eating the 灵芝 is completed before he feels better (了completed).
Content
…他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃 → …他的朋友哪一种植物能不能吃: Use 种 for a type of plant: 哪一种植物.
Expressiveness
At “发现了夹竹桃有毒。 ”: Add how badly Shennong’s stomach hurt after he ate the flower. For example: 他的肚子很疼。
At “别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。 ”: Describe the helper as a man in blue clothes and show that he helped quickly. For example: 一个穿蓝衣服的男人马上帮助他。
At “神农一吃就觉得比较好。 ”: Add Shennong’s thankful words and his question about the plant. For example: 他说： “谢谢你！这是什么植物？ ”
Encouragement You clearly included the important rescue: someone gives Shennong 灵芝 and he feels better. You also showed that he keeps writing down what he learns to help his friends know which plants are safe.
Content & completeness (after the whole story)
After 神农 starts recording plants, add that he finds 茶 and writes it down.
When 神农 eats 夹竹桃, say clearly that he faints, before someone gives him 灵芝.
After 神农 feels better from 灵芝, add another person in brown who comes and talks with him.
